hook: Nearly 3,000 leaders arrived at Davos during the 56th Annual Meeting.

sections.voiceover: Nearly 3,000 leaders arrived at Davos during the 56th Annual Meeting.

During the 56th Annual Meeting in Davos, representatives gathered from 130 countries. Rashimah Rajah authored research about authentic leadership at the University of Twente. What drives real impact in modern organizations?
CEOs Mershad Javan and Michael Riedl joined discussions, but artificial intelligence changed everything.
The World Economic Forum published a 28 minute and 21 second audio podcast. Davos panels connected core principles with decisions.
